experiment_data.hypothesis: True oracle SDF refinement using GT point cloud + numerical gradient (finite difference δ=1mm) — bypasses learned decoder entirely. Determines theoretical upper bound of action-space SDF gradient refinement. All previous "oracle" experiments used learned decoder (M027). Pass criteria: CAR ≥88% (baseline+5pp), moving episode collision rate <50%, displacement >10mm. If pass → method is viable, decoder training needs fixing. If fail → action-space SDF refinement is fundamentally insufficient.
